QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Can We Really Do This?
QuestInfo.0: #p2154010##k #b the Lead Researcher in #m310060000# in the Mine is struggling with something.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154010# is worried about the growing number of raccoons, not to mention all the other creatures #p2154009#'s experiments are putting in danger. He wants you to see what creatures #p2154009's keeping# inside the new laboratory. Go all the way to the end of the shaft, #bwhere the raccoons are#k.
QuestInfo.2: You found a strange creature in Mine Shaft 3 who had ores decorated on its body. When you told #p2154010#, he was surprised and exclaimed that he didn't expect a Baby Ore Muncher to be captured in there, too. An Ore Muncher is a rare creature that only lives in this shaft and is considered a mystical creature in Edelstein...

0.0: I've been trying to ignore it but... #p2154009#'s research is becoming more and more dangerous. So many raccoons have been and are continuing to be sacrificed for the sake of 'research'... Even creatures that shouldn't be used are being experimented on.

yes.0: Great, please go look inside the laboratory. It's probably locked, so you won't be able to enter. Just peek inside.
